hook: $34.97 fix for closets with zero floor space

scenes.visual_prompt: Shot of a narrow reach-in coat closet, door barely clearing a floor-standing shoe rack
scenes.on_screen_text: when there's no floor space left
scenes.voiceover: Not every closet has room for a freestanding rack — sometimes there's just no floor to spare.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of the Simple Houseware 2-tier sliding basket organizer mounted on a shelf, chrome rails visible
scenes.voiceover: This one's $34.97 and it's actually built as an under-sink organizer, but the sliding rail mechanism works exactly the same for shoes.

scenes.visual_prompt: Hand sliding the basket forward on rails to grab a pair of shoes without squatting
scenes.voiceover: It slides forward on rails instead of eating floor space, so you're not rummaging through a pile on the ground.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot showing the two-tier stacked design fitting into a narrow closet gap
scenes.voiceover: Two tiers stacked vertically means it uses height, not floor footprint — which is the thing narrow closets are actually short on.

scenes.visual_prompt: Text overlay comparing this against a $89.99 freestanding bench
scenes.on_screen_text: priced like an accessory, not furniture
scenes.voiceover: At $34.97 it's priced like one piece of a closet system, not the whole solution.

scenes.visual_prompt: Final closet shot, door closing easily now that the floor is clear
scenes.voiceover: It's one of five picks I compared by closet size — link's in bio.

caption: If your closet door won't clear a floor rack, don't force one in. This $34.97 sliding basket mounts up instead of out. Full 5-pick comparison by closet type on the blog, link in bio.
